title: Psychiatric Medication Management
h1: Psychiatric Medication Management in American Fork & Throughout Utah
audience: People who want a thoughtful medication evaluation, a second look at prior treatment, help with side effects/tolerability, or ongoing psychiatric prescribing.
approach: Medication decisions are an ongoing process: understand the target symptoms, review prior response and adverse effects, consider medical/sleep/substance/lifestyle factors, choose thoughtfully, monitor function and safety, and adjust based on real response.

title: ADHD Evaluation & Medication Management
h1: ADHD Evaluation & Medication Management in Utah
audience: Children, adolescents, and adults with attention, executive-function, impulsivity, organization, task-initiation, or treatment-tolerability concerns.
approach: Evaluation should consider developmental history, impairment across settings, sleep, anxiety/mood, substance use, medical factors, prior medication trials, and alternative explanations. Treatment may include medication plus practical behavioral/environmental supports.

title: Anxiety & Depression Treatment
h1: Anxiety & Depression Psychiatric Care in American Fork & Utah
audience: People with persistent worry, panic, social anxiety, low mood, anhedonia, irritability, fatigue, sleep disruption, or incomplete response to prior treatment.
approach: Clarify symptom pattern, severity, function, safety, sleep, medical contributors, substances, therapy, prior medication response, and patient goals. Medication may be one part of a broader plan.

title: Women’s Mental Health
h1: Women’s Mental Health & Psychiatric Medication Management in Utah
audience: Women seeking psychiatric care across reproductive and life-stage transitions, including mood/anxiety/ADHD concerns and medication questions around pregnancy or postpartum when clinically appropriate.
approach: Keep this page within current psychiatric scope. Emphasize individualized risk-benefit decisions, coordination with OB/GYN/PCP/therapist when authorized, and avoidance of one-size-fits-all medication claims.

title: Addiction & Recovery Psychiatry
h1: Psychiatric Care for Addiction Recovery & Co-Occurring Mental Health Needs
audience: People in recovery or treatment who also need psychiatric evaluation/medication management for ADHD, anxiety, depression, trauma, sleep, mood symptoms, or substance-use treatment.
approach: Position Ischys as outpatient psychiatric continuity: addiction-informed care, co-occurring psychiatric treatment, medication for opioid use disorder when appropriate, and collaboration with treatment/recovery teams with consent.

title: Trauma & PTSD Psychiatric Care
h1: Trauma & PTSD Psychiatric Medication Management in Utah
audience: People with trauma-related symptoms who need psychiatric evaluation or medication management alongside therapy or other trauma-focused care.
approach: Medication management can target specific symptoms/conditions while respecting the role of evidence-based psychotherapy. Avoid implying medication erases trauma. Coordinate with therapists when authorized.

title: Integrative Psychiatry
h1: Integrative Psychiatry in American Fork & Throughout Utah
audience: Patients who want standard psychiatric care plus thoughtful discussion of sleep, nutrition, movement, supplements or other evidence-informed adjuncts when relevant.
approach: Define “integrative” as adding clinically relevant context—not replacing evidence-based care. Discuss evidence strength, interactions, medical conditions, product quality, and uncertainty. Natural does not automatically mean safe or effective.

title: What to Expect at Your First Visit
h1: What to Expect at Your First Psychiatric Visit at Ischys
audience: New patients and families preparing for an evaluation.
approach: Explain the 60-minute new-patient evaluation, history/review of prior treatment, current symptoms/function, medications/supplements/substances, medical/sleep factors, goals, records when clinically appropriate, and shared decision-making.

title: Referring Providers
h1: Psychiatric Medication Management for Your Therapy & Medical Referrals
audience: Therapists, psychologists, PCPs, OB/GYN clinicians, treatment programs, discharge teams, and other professionals.
approach: Core promise: psychiatric medication management that supports the existing treatment relationship. With patient authorization, close the loop and coordinate relevant care. Make referral steps obvious.
